ctx.x: And he didn't want you to --

He was giving me writeups when I was back with Louis Armstrong, and when he was featuring me as Louis II, he was giving me the writeups too, you know. He was sending them Hot Clubs of France books and I'd never met him, you know. Then he come, when I moved to New York he come over, and so we had him up to a big chicken dinner thing, and Madeleine was talking about that this year, you know. He said, "I never yet tasted chicken like you cooked it." We killed him up here, you know. It was quite some time ago. So he…

1 French discographer, author-compiler of Hot Discography. 1st edition 1936.
